messages:
incbot: [ALERT] High error rate + latency after deploy
incbot: severity=high metric=5xx_rate increased by 2.3% in the last 2m, p95=1.2s p99=5.6s, rollout=canary-2026-03-17b
incbot: affected route=/v1/generate, region=us-west-2, hosts=canary-pool-7

erin-oncall: seeing the alert, pulling up dashboards now -> https://dashboard.redwood/internal/alerts/1745556789 :eyes:
erin-oncall: can confirm spike starts ~1745556720 which matches canary deploy timestamp

sam-sre: loading request traces, lots of 502/504 from upstream transformer pool. KV cache misses spiked, connection retries increased
sam-sre: sample tail logs:
```
[2026-03-17T14:32:05Z] host=canary-7 id=abc123 status=504 upstream=transformer-12 latency=3.9s
[2026-03-17T14:32:06Z] host=canary-7 id=abc124 status=502 error="upstream hang"
```

julia-pm: any customer impact seen in CS?

mike-support: small but real. CS report: ~10 customer sessions got timeouts in last 10m, one support ticket opened for 500s on /v1/generate, priority=P2. No broad outage yet, but trend is bad.

erin-oncall: scope looks limited to canary pool and that rollout tag. I recommend immediate rollback of canary to previous stable (v2026-03-16-0815) while we investigate. Rolling forward risks wider blast.

sam-sre: agree. Starting rollback now. Running rollback script and disabling canary pool routing.
sam-sre: command:
```bash
./ops/deploy rollback --env=prod --target=v2026-03-16-0815 --tag=canary-2026-03-17b --drain=true
```
sam-sre: disabling canary routing rule (route weight -> 0) and draining in-flight requests. ETA ~45s.

incbot: [INFO] rollback started by sam-sre at 1745556800

erin-oncall: I'll watch metrics and traces, notify CS on status. If rollback doesn't improve within 3 minutes we escalate to full revert and pager the infra lead.

sam-sre: rollback completed. ops note: canary pool removed from LB, traffic back to stable pool. New deployment state: stable=v2026-03-16-0815.
sam-sre: immediate metrics: 5xx rate trending down, p99 dropped from 5.6s -> 0.9s over last 90s.

incbot: [RESOLVE] alert auto-update: error rate reduced to baseline, p99=0.92s, 5xx delta <0.1%

julia-pm: thanks. Mike, can you prepare a short customer-facing blurb (what happened, who was affected, what's done) so CS can send to affected customers? Keep it simple and actionable.

mike-support: on it, will post a draft in #support-cs in 10m and ping you.

erin-oncall: postmortem owner: @sam-sre to lead. Action items off the top:
- validate canary traffic weighting and autoscaling smoothing (reduce hot cutover)
- add an automated canary rollback threshold for p99 > 3s OR 5xx delta > 1%
- investigate KV cache warmup behavior under new model variant
- add more granular tracing for upstream transformer timeouts
Linking runbooks: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/incident-timeouts

erin-oncall: handing off monitoring to @sam-sre for 1hr of post-rollback observation. If regressions reappear, page me immediately. :thumbsup:

sam-sre: acknowledged. I'll own postmortem and follow-ups, will schedule deep-dive with ML infra and rollout owners tomorrow.

mike-support: draft sent to #support-cs, flagged ~10 customers, escalated one to priority follow-up.

julia-pm: add customer impact summary to incident tracker and include timeline. I'll coordinate comms if any enterprise customers need an incident report.

erin-oncall: closing this thread for active mitigation, leaving it open for postmortem updates. Thank you all.
